scheme_name: Retirement Relief in Quitting Service for the Construction Workers
state: UT Administration of Dadra and Nagar Haveli and Daman and Diu
other_conditions: Must be a registered member of the Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board of the UT
Must have been a member of the Board for a continuous period of 15 years
Must have engaged in building or other construction work for at least 90 days in a given year
Must request a prescribed format and attach mandatory documents (self‑attested if required)
benefits_summary: A certain amount is paid to eligible construction workers who have been board members continuously for 15 years upon retirement at age 60.
